Date: 2022-04-21 What is claimed is:
1. A mobile warning apparatus for issuing a warning in response to observation of a mobile object approaching a vehicle, the mobile warning apparatus comprising:
a velocity calculator configured to calculate, based on observation information observed by a sensor installed in the vehicle, one or more relative velocities of one or more observed points;
a position determiner configured to determine whether the
observed points are in a predetermined proximity extent; and
an eliminator configured to eliminate, in response to determination that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent, all the observed points from a warning target.
2. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 1, wherein:
the relative velocities include at least one first relative velocity in a first direction approaching the vehicle, and at least one second relative velocity in a second direction moving away from the vehicle.
3. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 1, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among positions of the respective observed points observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to a predetermined position threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the positions of the respective observed points observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined position threshold.
4. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 2, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among positions of the respective observed points observed by the sensor are smaller than or
equal to a predetermined position threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the positions of the respective observed points observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined
position threshold.
5. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 1, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among azimuths of the
respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to a predetermined azimuth threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the azimuths of the respective observed points
relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined azimuth threshold.
6. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 2, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to a predetermined azimuth threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined azimuth threshold.
7. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 3, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to a predetermined azimuth threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the
predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined azimuth threshold.
8. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 4, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to a predetermined azimuth threshold; and determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the azimuths of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined azimuth threshold.
9. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 1, wherein:
the position determiner is configured to:
determine whether differences among distances of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor
are smaller than or equal to a predetermined distance threshold; and
determine that the observed points are in the predetermined proximity extent in response to determination that the differences among the distances of the respective observed points relative to the vehicle observed by the sensor are smaller than or equal to the predetermined distance threshold.
10. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 5. further comprising:
an azimuth threshold determiner configured to determine a value
of the azimuth threshold as a function of a distance of at least one observed point relative to the vehicle, the at least one observed point being included in the observed points.
11. The mobile warning apparatus according to claim 9, further comprising:
a distance threshold determiner configured to determine a value of the distance threshold as a function of an echo intensity of at least one observed point included in the observed points. 29 30 31 32 5 10 15 20 25 30
